description: Ground truth mappings for incident triage evaluation and baseline benchmark.

smoke_prompts.prompt: Investigate incident INC-1001 on the checkout service. Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and what remediation action you would recommend.

Investigate incident INC-1002 on the payments service. Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and what remediation action you would recommend.
Investigate incident INC-1003. Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and what remediation action you would recommend.
Investigate incident INC-1004. Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and whether any action is needed.

INC-1001.symptom_summary: Checkout API p99 latency spiked from 180ms to 2420ms; 504 Gateway Timeouts elevated to 4.2%.
INC-1001.expected_root_cause: Recent deployment v2.14.0 (commit a9f3b12) introduced an unindexed N+1 database query loop in PricingEngine.apply_bundle_discount.

INC-1002.symptom_summary: Payments charge processing returning HTTP 500 errors; transaction failure rate is 18.5%.
INC-1002.expected_root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion on payments service (100/100 active connections saturated with ConnectionPoolTimeoutException).
red_herrings: Recent deployment DEP-4109 on notification-service (v1.8.0) deployed at 14:05 UTC. It is unrelated and healthy.

INC-1003.symptom_summary: Ingress TLS handshake failures and login errors; 45% authentication error rate.
INC-1003.expected_root_cause: TLS certificate *.auth.internal.example.com on auth-gateway expired on 2025-05-10T00:00:00Z.

INC-1004.symptom_summary: Elevated p95 latency alert (820ms) on search-service.
INC-1004.expected_root_cause: Scheduled synthetic load test runner job-8842 generating 5000 QPS (14:00-14:30 UTC). Error rate is 0.0% and system is self-resolving.
